what: performance audit, three findings: the whole store file is rewritten on every comment, a page's list is built and compressed again on every load, and pins wait for a round trip after the page
comments saved one file per page, each page's list kept until it changes, month-old done threads archived
pages come with their comments in them: the widget draws its pins without asking first, one round trip less
reverted: pages no longer carry their comments in them, the widget asks for them as before

dropped.why: too complicated for one round trip less
